pokedexEntries.rb: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

pokedexEntries.ye: Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers and shallow puddles.

pokedexEntries.go: An underpowered, pathetic POKéMON. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

pokedexEntries.si: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like PIDGEOTTO to catch it mid-jump.

pokedexEntries.cr: This weak and pathetic POKéMON gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.

pokedexEntries.ru: MAGIKARP is a pathetic excuse for a POKéMON that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.

pokedexEntries.sa: MAGIKARP is virtually useless in battle as it can only splash around. As a result, it is considered to be weak. However, it is actually a very hardy POKéMON that can survive in any body of water no matter how polluted it is.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.

pokedexEntries.lg: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

pokedexEntries.em: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.

pokedexEntries.di: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

pokedexEntries.prl: It is unable to swim against even slow-moving currents. It always splashes about for some reason.

pokedexEntries.pt: A MAGIKARP living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

pokedexEntries.hg: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.

pokedexEntries.ss: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like PIDGEOTTO to catch it mid-jump.

pokedexEntries.bw: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

pokedexEntries.as: Magikarp is virtually useless in battle as it can only splash around. As a result, it is considered to be weak. However, it is actually a very hardy Pokémon that can survive in any body of water no matter how polluted it is.

pokedexEntries.su: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you’ll soon grow tired of seeing them.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its reckless leaps make it easy pickings for predators. On the bright side, many Pokémon enjoy longer life spans, thanks to Magikarp.

pokedexEntries.us: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

pokedexEntries.um: Thanks to their strong hold on life, dirty water doesn’t bother them at all. They live in waters all over the world!

pokedexEntries.shp: It is unable to swim against even slow-moving currents. It always splashes about for some reason.

pokedexEntries.la: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.
